capabilities: Sync tasks bidirectionally with CalDAV servers as VTODO items
Map task metadata (dates, priority, recurrence, tags, notes) to CalDAV fields
Filter which tasks sync per calendar by Obsidian tag and server category
Detect and resolve sync conflicts manually or automatically
Preview syncs with dry-run mode and schedule auto-sync at set intervals
disambiguation: Not vault or device syncing; it syncs individual obsidian-tasks items with external CalDAV servers as VTODO entries.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. iCloud Reminders is not supported directly because Apple does not expose it as standard CalDAV/VTODO; the README documents a workaround via a standards-compliant CalDAV account such as fruux. Priority mapping is lossy in the CalDAV-to-Obsidian direction, and the plugin depends on obsidian-tasks' internal getTasks() API, which could break in future updates.
intentEvidence: Works with the obsidian-tasks plugin — syncs task status, dates, priorities, recurrence, tags, and notes as standard VTODO
problem: Tasks in Obsidian are locked inside the vault; there is no built-in way to push or pull them to calendar and task servers like Nextcloud or Fastmail.
